title: NovaStack Pack
description: An aesthetically pleasing Crystal PvP texture pack that blends clean, modern visuals with sharp combat clarity.
body:
# NovaStack Pack
# **Video Showcase** **Novastack pack** is a competitive texture pack focused on visibility, performance, and clean aesthetics, blending elements from all my favourite texture packs. # Features: * Clean, modern textures designed for Crystal PvP * Improved combat clarity and reduced visual clutter * No explosion sound effects * No explosion particles * Low fire for better visibility during fights * Additional PvP-focused optimizations This pack is designed to help players stay focused during fast-paced Crystal PvP combat while maintaining a sleek and visually appealing style. _**Compatible with Minecraft 26.1 and newer.**_ **Credits**: tristanfour, themagicalcats, nazarbatrider, sakura, sqidgeon, masterofdeath, piuvas, dokzera and gitq.
